task: Answer: 'What is the evidence for semaglutide reducing cardiovascular events?' with citations

nodes.label: Plan approach
nodes.input: User question about semaglutide CV outcomes. Decide tools + steps.
nodes.output: Plan: 1) search PubMed for SELECT trial 2) pull abstracts 3) draft answer with citations 4) verify each claim.

nodes.label: search_pubmed
nodes.input: query='semaglutide cardiovascular outcomes SELECT trial', retmax=5
nodes.output: 5 PMIDs returned (incl. 37952131 — SELECT primary results, NEJM 2023).

nodes.label: get_abstract (SELECT)
nodes.output: Semaglutide 2.4mg: 20% reduction in MACE (HR 0.80, 95% CI 0.72-0.90) vs placebo in overweight/obese CVD patients without diabetes.

nodes.label: get_abstract (meta-analysis)
nodes.output: Abstract truncated; full text behind paywall. Only conclusion sentence available.

nodes.label: Draft answer
nodes.input: Synthesize SELECT + meta-analysis into a cited answer.
nodes.output: Semaglutide reduced MACE by 20% (SELECT, NEJM 2023) [1]. A 2022 meta-analysis was broadly consistent [2].

eval.note: Cited [2] for a claim the partial abstract doesn't support

nodes.label: Citation check
nodes.input: Verify each claim maps to retrieved evidence.
nodes.output: Claim 2 unsupported by retrieved text → route back to revise.

nodes.label: Revise answer
nodes.input: Drop or hedge the unsupported meta-analysis claim.
nodes.output: Semaglutide 2.4mg reduced MACE by 20% vs placebo (HR 0.80; SELECT, NEJM 2023) [1]. Evidence beyond this trial was not retrievable in full.
